result.note: Tests the July 2026 approval of Qdenga as India's first dengue vaccine and its approved age range.

questions.prompt: In July 2026, India approved Qdenga, a vaccine against dengue. Consider the following statements about it:
items: It was approved for use in people aged 9 to 45 years.
It is Takeda's vaccine and the first dengue vaccine approved in India.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 1 is wrong because Qdenga was approved for ages 4 to 60, not 9 to 45. As India's first approved dengue vaccine, it sets the regulatory benchmark that domestic vaccine candidates will have to beat.
questions.source: India approved its first dengue vaccine, Takeda's Qdenga, for ages 4 to 60, setting the regulatory benchmark domestic candidates will have to beat.
